notes.title: Liminal City - Official Reveal Trailer
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I am incredibly excited to finally reveal the first official trailer for Liminal City, the psychological horror game I’ve developed, inspired by the eerie depths of Backrooms Level 11.

Watch the Official Reveal on IGN!
[previewyoutube=eCA8dnvhA3s;full][/previewyoutube]

Liminal City is an ultra-realistic horror exploration game where you get lost in Backrooms Level 11. With VHS style analog horror visuals, dynamic level transitions, and deep psychological horror, this game will take you on a truly disturbing journey.

Wishlist Now!

I’d love to hear your thoughts! What do you think of the trailer? Are you ready to step into the unknown? Let me know in the comments!
